name: B10-0187/2024 (The Left) – The shrinking space for civil society in Cambodia, in particular the case of the labour rights organisation CENTRAL
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the shrinking space for civil society in Cambodia, in particular the case of the labour rights organisation CENTRAL
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and asking for action. It condemns Cambodia's shrinking space for civil society and the pressure on the labour rights group CENTRAL. It asks Cambodia to drop charges against CENTRAL, fix its trade union and NGO laws, and protect workers. It asks European clothing brands to protect workers' rights in their supply chains, and asks the European Union to act against companies that harm people or the environment.

- No law changes; Parliament asks Cambodia to drop charges against CENTRAL and fix its laws.
- Nearly one million garment workers, mostly women, and European brands like H&M and Inditex are affected.
- Next, the resolution goes to European Union institutions, member states and Cambodian authorities; they decide whether to act.
